**Digest 2026-10-12 UTC** · CD Tracker (67 rows) · since 2026-10-11

**Summary**
• AUD-17: the 30 live runs on CausalArena's named scenarios are done (about $12.7). Real names raise directed F1 by 0.09 on average, but by 0.10 or more in only 5 of 10 scenarios, so the pre-registered 'names carry the score' prediction is refuted. With swapped names the model follows the labels (81 of 101 edges); with neutral names the agent ends below plain PC in 8 of 10 scenarios. 6 of 30 runs crashed in the cycle-removal step, 5 of them with real names
• TGT-17: our frozen refinement rule (v1) beat the pipeline's own bootstrap step on all 30 live tables, but it is not 'never below the algorithm' on held-out data (40 of 55 tables). It drops true edges that appear in few resamples. A v2 that never deletes the algorithm's edges is frozen; on development data it meets all three predictions; its held-out test is next
• REP-15: baselines now cover the formula and synthetic families for PC, GES, FCI, LiNGAM and NOTEARS. Only PC depends on column order, and the cause is the causal-learn version bundled with Causal-Copilot (the current causal-learn release showed none on 22 test files). CAP-17: every row is packaged in the scoreboard format and passes the official validator. AVICI is blocked: its checkpoint host is not reachable from our machines
• REP-09: the Causal Chambers authors' GES baseline is reproduced exactly (same graph class, same precision and recall). DOM-14 is complete: 'what if we set X' answers at 25 variables take under 0.1 s; the limit is the accuracy of the recovered graph, not computation
• Next: v2's held-out test and the name-only questions (under $1), then the 2 Nov checkpoint (DLV-05)
